canonical_oce_target: OCE B6 Evaluation Service / evaluator freeze governance
replacement_condition: replace when the canonical evaluator service owns protocol freeze
notes: A fixture benchmark, not a quality claim. Six items, two required seeds, four declared dimensions.

protocol.author: foundry.evaluation.fixture

metrics.name: calibration_error
metrics.description: mean absolute deviation between stated confidence and correctness

metrics.name: instruction_adherence
metrics.description: fraction of items respecting the declared answer format

metrics.name: refusal_precision
metrics.description: fraction of refusals that were appropriate

decision_rules: a dimension may only be reported with its sample size and seed count
no dimension may be aggregated into a single master score
an improvement is only claimed when the delta exceeds the declared tolerance and the run is powered
